sloka: यैः सायकैः सालवरा निकृत्ता वाली हतो वानरपुङ्गवश्च।ते कुम्भकर्णस्य तदा शरीरे वज्रोपमा न व्यथयाम्प्रचक्रुः ।। ६.६७.१४१ ।।
transliteration: yaiḥ sāyakaiḥ sālavarā nikṛttā vālī hato vānarapuṅgavaśca।te kumbhakarṇasya tadā śarīre vajropamā na vyathayāmpracakruḥ ।। 6.67.141 ।।

translations.english: Surrounded by Rakshasas, he was searching for Vanaras, like an elephant, guarding a quarter, searches.
